title: "formal-spanish"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r load library, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(magrittr)
library(ggeffects)
```

```{r load data}
raw <- bind_rows(read.csv("../data/formal-pilot/data-task-pkec.csv"), read.csv("../data/formal-pilot/data-task-pkec2.csv")) %>%
  rename(ID = 'Participant.Private.ID',
         stim = 'Spreadsheet..stim',
         trial_type = 'Spreadsheet..trial_type',
         blockID = 'Spreadsheet..blockID',
         rt = 'Reaction.Time', 
         condition = 'Spreadsheet..condition')%>%
  filter(Display == "phonetic categorization") %>%
  filter(Response.Type == "response") %>%
  filter(Response != "") %>%                    # drop screen-advance events (blank Response)
  mutate(
    catch = case_when(
      str_detect(stim, "left")  ~ Spreadsheet..left,
      str_detect(stim, "right") ~ Spreadsheet..right,
    ))%>%
  mutate(catch.corr = if_else(catch == Response, 1, 0))%>%
  mutate(VOT = as.numeric(str_extract(stim, "(?<=_)[^.]+"))) %>%
  mutate(resp.num = case_when(
      str_detect(Response, "^t") ~ 1,
      str_detect(Response, "^d") ~ 0)) %>%
  mutate(word = str_extract(stim, "^[^_]+" ))
```

```{r}

participant.condition <- raw %>%
  filter(condition != "") %>%
  distinct(ID, condition)

data.plot <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch") %>%      
  mutate(blockID = factor(blockID, levels = c("T1", "A", "T2", "B", "T3", "C", "T4", "T5", "T6"))) %>%
  select(VOT, resp.num, ID, blockID, word, stim) %>% 
  left_join(participant.condition, by = "ID") %>% 
  group_by(condition, blockID, ID) %>%
  summarise(prop.t = mean(resp.num), .groups = "drop")%>%
  group_by(condition, blockID) %>%
  summarise(mean.prop = mean(prop.t), .groups = "drop") 


ggplot(data.plot, aes(x = blockID, y = mean.prop, colour = condition, group = condition)) +   
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Block", y = "Proportion /t/-responses", colour = "Exposure condition") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


```
